name: am.kayq/catalogue
title: KAYQ - Armenian website catalogue
description: Search KAYQ, the Armenian website catalogue: listings, categories, topics, top sites, site status.

tools.name: search_websites
tools.description: Finds websites in KAYQ, the reviewed catalogue of Armenian websites (kayq.am): shops, banks, services, media, travel, education and more. Give words in Armenian, English or Russian (Armenian may be typed in Latin letters), a category or a topic, or any of them together. Every word must be found in a website's name, address, description or keywords, or in its category or topic; a word found nowhere is ignored. Returns real listings only, most visited first, each with its own address and its KAYQ page. Use list_categories for the category and topic slugs.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "car rental", "ավտոմեքենաների վարձույթ", "доставка цветов", "list.am".

category.description: A category slug from list_categories, e.g. "banks", "travel".

topic.description: A topic slug from list_categories, e.g. "car-rental".

language.description: Language of the names, descriptions and links: hy (Armenian), en (English) or ru (Russian).

tools.name: get_website
tools.description: Everything KAYQ knows about one listed website: its name, address, category and topics, its full description and keywords, the phone, address and social profiles it publishes, when it was listed, whether it answered KAYQ's last check, and its trust report (domain age and expiry, HTTPS certificate, 30-day uptime, site check problems, platform, languages, verified owner). Give its domain ("list.am"), its address or its KAYQ slug.

website.description: The domain ("list.am"), the address ("https://www.list.am/") or the KAYQ slug ("list-am").

language.description: Language of the names, descriptions and links: hy (Armenian), en (English) or ru (Russian).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The categories of KAYQ (banks, stores, travel, IT, health...) and the topics inside each (car rental, job sites, hotels...), with how many websites each holds and its page. Use the slugs with search_websites and most_visited.

language.description: Language of the names, descriptions and links: hy (Armenian), en (English) or ru (Russian).

tools.name: most_visited
tools.description: The websites KAYQ visitors opened most in the last 30 days, overall or in one category, with the number of visits.

category.description: A category slug from list_categories; leave it out for all of KAYQ.

language.description: Language of the names, descriptions and links: hy (Armenian), en (English) or ru (Russian).

tools.name: website_status
tools.description: Whether a listed website answered KAYQ's latest check, its response time, and the share of good answers over 24 hours and 7 days. KAYQ checks the most visited websites every hour and the others once a day, from a server in Europe.

website.description: The domain ("list.am"), the address or the KAYQ slug.

language.description: Language of the names, descriptions and links: hy (Armenian), en (English) or ru (Russian).
